observed_failure.tank_state: Feraltank remained in generation-3 combat against party-linked entry 42808 and 42810 hostiles

combat_falsifier.conclusion: The watchdog did not invent an idle world, but it correctly observed a broken party: the tank continued real combat while all four followers lacked usable assist focus and accumulated stuck failures.

accepted_causal_chain: Rerun143 changed the generic Feral area branch from unconditional shared-focus publication to publication only for boss nodes or isEligibleTrashClusterMob targets.
Generation 3 legitimately combat-linked the party to nearby Stonecore Flayer entry 42808 while the current node's declared pack entries did not include 42808.
The Feral selected and attacked the tank-owned 42808 cluster, but the broad new guard did not publish that target as shared route focus.

For followers, routeUsableCombatTarget also rejects non-current-pack trash unless it is the explicit shared bounded terminal combat focus, so the tank's tactical TargetGuid could not become a usable group focus.
The four followers fell into no-focus anchor movement and unreachable/partial route recovery while the Feral continued Thrash, Swipe, melee, and incoming combat for another 34.168 seconds.
Repeated follower-local stuck events triggered the strict machine-failure predicate before generation 3 could terminalize.

rejected_alternatives.name: healthy_coordinated_combat_watchdog_false_positive
rejected_alternatives.reason: Only the tank produced all 187 post-failure combat events; four followers had target_id zero and repeated no-focus anchor recovery, so party coordination was genuinely broken.

rejected_alternatives.name: rerun142_density_ordering_failure
rejected_alternatives.reason: The proactive density selector requires at least 12 engaged hostiles; the failure is explained earlier by shared-focus eligibility and persists while ordinary tank attacks execute.

rejected_alternatives.name: immediate_next_encounter_ownership_regression
rejected_alternatives.reason: Entry 42808 is not an immediate-next generation-4 boss member at generation 3. The intended suppression boundary was broader than the authorized immediate-next-encounter rule.

rejected_alternatives.name: identity_or_publication_failure
rejected_alternatives.reason: Exact party and identity matched; the operator closed, cleanup passed, the capture revalidated, and both DVC bundles were remotely verified.

smallest_safe_correction.scope: generic Feral area target shared-focus publication only
smallest_safe_correction.change: Publish the selected tactical target as shared focus unless it is a manifest-classified immediate-next-encounter member. This restores current party assist for other combat-linked trash while retaining rerun142's exact next-boss/add isolation.
